messages:
Mara: heads up - supplier pushed ETA for batch #8 from 2025-05-01 -> 2025-05-18. This wipes our staging window and will block the h100 topoff next week. need decision: expedite air for part of the batch or reroute to FRA crossdock and accept delay.

Josh: qty + cost delta? finance needs roughs to sign off.

Mara: 12x H100. Sea arrival is baseline, expedited air adds ~18k total and moves 6-12 units to ~2025-05-05 depending on routing. Crossdock reroute cuts cost but adds unpredictable customs 3-5 days.

Lia: impacts dedicated-pool eu-west-1 SLA next week -> ~120k tokens capacity loss if we get zero. Can we borrow from reserved pool temporarily?

supply-bot: [automated] Shipment 3PL-98765 ETA changed. Tags: #BATCH8 #H100 #staging-impact. Notifying: eng-sre, procurement, ops.

Ryan (ops): prefer split: expedite air for 6 units to meet topoff, hold remaining 6 at FRA crossdock with RMA-prep. Cuts cost and preserves some capacity.

Sam (customs): air requires HS-code reclass + paperwork pre-filed or customs may inspect -> +48-72h risk. If supplier signs commercial invoice with matched declared value and HS 8471.50 we can often avoid a physical inspection.

Anna (carrier): we can pre-clear for air with broker fee ~1.2k. Need invoice + origin packing list within 24h to schedule pickup. Can route via FRA gateway.

Josh: finance check - do we have a buffer for expedited fees or need PO amendment?

Mara: procurement covers up to $10k. Remaining ~8k needs finance credit note. Proposal: company absorbs 10k, request finance approve delta, expedite 6 units.

Ryan (ops): also want RMA-H100-v2 labels applied to the 6 held units at crossdock so depot processing is ready if DOA. Saves depot trips.

Lia: ops please run quick telemetry sim: if only 6 added, what customer latency impact by product tier? we need numbers to prioritize topoff recipients.

Mara: pasted manifest: 
```
AWB: 5X-12345678
Supplier: NorthEast Compute Ltd
SKU: H100-48GB x12
Batch: BATCH8
ETA_old: 2025-05-01
ETA_new: 2025-05-18
```

Anna (carrier): confirm pre-clear possible if invoice follows Sam's checklist. Pickup possible 24-36h after docs submitted. Extra broker fee billed to Redwood.

Josh: tagging finance for approval on ~$9.2k delta (air share + broker). Also need PO amendment flow.

Sam (customs): I'll draft pre-clear checklist and share with Anna + supplier. Will include HS, invoice signature, and declared value guidance.

Mara: summary/proposed action: 1) expedite air for 6 units to meet topoff window (approx +9k) 2) reroute and hold 6 units at FRA crossdock with RMA labels 3) procurement covers 10k, request finance for remaining delta 4) customs to pre-file HS 8471.50 where possible 5) ops to run telemetry ticket and prepare crate/RMA.

Ryan (ops): creating OPS-7823 to track telemetry + crate prep. Will add checklist for RMA labels.

supply-bot: [automated] Created OPS-7823 and procurement PR-44821.

Lia: will post telemetry snapshot in OPS-7823 once sim runs complete.

Josh: +1 on plan. Mara please start PO amendment + supplier sign-off for commercial invoice. Finance please ack. :thumbsup: 

Anna (carrier): booked broker hold tentatively, awaiting docs from supplier.

Mara: proceeding to vendor sign-off. If finance greenlights, we push air tomorrow. Otherwise full crossdock with consolidated RMA flow as fallback.

Josh: finance ack pending, will update thread. :money_with_wings:
